## Mapping Decisions

- The source already arrives in Senzing JSON; the mapping routes values verbatim (verbatim check passes).
- RECORD_TYPE comes from each record's own FEATURES.RECORD_TYPE (type discriminator); person names on PERSON records, NAME_ORG on ORGANIZATION records, both kept on the 3 untyped records (2215, 3022, 3024).
- NPI_NUMBER (healthcare provider ID, 4 records) is mapped to its own NPI_NUMBER feature.
- Card columns (account ID, last four digits, role, product, credit limit, balance, open date, status, delinquency) are payload for the customer 360; PAN_LAST4 is only four digits, so it is not a usable CREDITCARD_NUMBER. No payload name collides with a reserved attribute.
- Feature objects holding only a usage-type label (2 PHONE_TYPE objects with no number) are dropped.

## Quality Notes

- Quality score 72.4 (completeness 65.1, format 87.3, duplicates 0); the bootcamper chose to continue to mapping.
- Email is 51.4% unique: info@ca-state.gov is on 13 cardholders, and record 2215 carries only that email (no name, no type).
- Sparse identifiers (SSN 12%, passport 11%, driver's licence 6%); each NPI is shared by 2 records.
- 8 ORGANIZATION names look person-like to the analyzer (no company suffix); they are typed ORGANIZATION in the source and left as-is.
